releases.title: Initial public checkpoint
releases.summary: The first tagged MOPA Laser Rasterizer release established the browser workflow for turning raster artwork into layered laser-ready output.

groups.title: Highlights
items: Converted raster artwork into color-separated vector geometry for laser workflows.
Generated layered SVG output and LightBurn projects backed by Material Library settings.
Introduced the core MOPA color engraving and fauxlographic experimentation workflows.

groups.title: Project foundation
items: Published the initial operator documentation and local development workflow.
Established the v1 data and output conventions that later releases continue to evolve.
